main_body: potted fern (plant leaves and terracotta pot)

evidence: The terracotta pot (rows 9-14) is drawn as a pure front-elevation trapezoid with a dead-flat horizontal top edge (row 9 dark brown line, row 10 light tan highlight band) and no elliptical opening or top surface.
